title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans — Booking a Late Charge on an Installment
content:
**Rule.** A late charge on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is booked as one fee entry against the installment most recently billed on the loan, and only while the loan is in active status, when that installment is still not paid in full after more than the product's late-charge grace period has passed since its due date, the due date itself being day 0; no entry is booked when that installment already carries a late charge.

## When an entry is booked

| Loan and installment on the booking day | Late-charge entry |
|---|---|
| Loan active; most recently billed installment not paid in full; more than the grace period since its due date; no late charge yet on it | one entry, against that installment bill |
| Loan in any status other than active | none |
| Grace period not yet exceeded (the day after the last grace day not yet reached) | none |
| Installment paid in full | none |
| Installment already carries a late charge | none |

The installment the entry is booked against is always the one most recently billed on the loan, read from the loan's installment bills by due date.

## The booking tool: `assess_installment_late_charge_7bb353d6`

**Capability.** The tool books a late charge on one installment bill of a member's equipment or vehicle loan: one late-charge fee entry against the installment bill named, dated today, for the amount given, which is added to the loan's fees not yet paid. Once booked, the charge shows in the loan's transaction history as a late-charge fee pointing to that installment bill, and the loan's fees due rise by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `assess_installment_late_charge_7bb353d6` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the equipment loan the installment belongs to, as returned by the equipment loan lookup | identifier |
| `source_ref_id` | the reference number of the installment bill (the interest billing entry of that installment) the late charge is charged on, as returned by the equipment loan transaction lookup | identifier |
| `late_charge_amount` | the late charge to book | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; the figure is passed already rounded to cents and is stored at 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A receipt with `fee_txn_id` (the reference number of the new late-charge fee entry), `loan_id` (the loan charged), `source_ref_id` (the installment bill charged), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the charge booked), `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date) and `fees_due` (USD, 2 decimal places, the loan's fees not yet paid after the charge). The presence of `fee_txn_id` indicates the charge was booked.

## Hypothetical input and receipt

Calling the tool with a loan number, the reference of the loan's latest installment bill and an amount of 90.00 returns a receipt carrying a new fee reference, that loan and bill, an amount of 90.00, today's date and the loan's fees due increased by 90.00.
